headline: OCI and Orascom shareholders approve merger into Abu Dhabi infrastructure giant
summary: Nassef Sawiris secured 99.85% shareholder support to consolidate OCI Global and Orascom Construction into an Abu Dhabi-based infrastructure and investment company targeting over $1 billion in new investments.
why: OCI Global and Orascom Construction are major international engineering, construction, and fertilizer enterprises controlled by the Sawiris family.

impacts.name: OCI Global
impacts.why: Shareholders approved the merger of OCI Global and Orascom Construction.
